name: compact_r_with_m_param
content:
Let me check the current directory.
<｜｜DSML｜｜r=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜m>pwd</｜｜DSML｜｜m>
</｜｜DSML｜｜r>

name: standard_with_typed_parameters
content:
I will execute the inspection tool.
<｜DSML｜tool_calls>
<invoke name="execute_bash">
<parameter name="command" string="true">cat /app/dist/index.js</parameter>
</invoke>
</｜DSML｜tool_calls>

name: standard_multiple_invokes
content:
<|DSML|tool_calls>
<invoke name="execute_bash">
<parameter name="command" string="true">echo hello</parameter>
</invoke>
<invoke name="execute_bash">
<parameter name="command" string="true">echo world</parameter>
</invoke>
</|DSML|tool_calls>

name: standard_with_non_string_params
content:
<｜DSML｜tool_calls>
<invoke name="execute_bash">
<parameter name="timeout" string="false">30</parameter>
<parameter name="flag" string="false">true</parameter>
<parameter name="command" string="true">ls</parameter>
</invoke>
</｜DSML｜tool_calls>

name: standard_single_invoke_single_param
content:
